author: _Stormz
body:
Nordic Holiday, a Nebula DTM map, created by trexdomobutter and StormzInvader.

This is a Christmas-themed map. 

What does it have?
  • Enchantment table
  • Each kill will award the player 3 Bottles o' Enchanting
  • Big Christmas tree in the center with an enchanted Nether Star on top
Loadout
  • Iron Sword
  • Full Leather Armor (Red and Green teams)
  • Diamond Pickaxe
  • Stone Axe
  • Bow (Infinity)
  • 1 Arrow
  • 3 Golden Apples
  • 32 Cooked Chicken
  • 64 Glass
  • 64 Spruce Wood Logs

Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?vajb2h45bp4rzq7
Imgur Album: http://imgur.com/a/QWY2e#jTwl6fP
YAML: http://pastebin.com/V2x7SbPG (Thanks to CaptainDCRaven for the help!)
